## Scope
Describe changed GF scripts / Engine / Registry and impacted asset classes or Deals.

## Validation
- [ ] Unit, registry, contract and integration tests pass
- [ ] Source-to-deployment mirrors are identical
- [ ] Golden snapshots reviewed (do not auto-update failed baselines)
- [ ] IronPython ASAP UAT completed or explicitly marked NOT PERFORMED
- [ ] GF names / first-callable behavior confirmed
- [ ] Severity, JSON and interruption behavior reviewed
- [ ] Security check (no client data or credentials)
- [ ] Production deployment is **not** implied by merging

## Backward compatibility and rollback
List previous contract and how to revert an approved bundle.
